text: Then I shall feel safe, whatever happens.” “Whatever happens? What do you mean? What is going to happen?” She turned away quietly and walked toward the hearth. “Nothing at present—except that I am very cold, and that before I go you must make up the fire for me.” She knelt on the hearth-rug, stretching her hands to the embers. Puzzled by the sudden change in her tone, he mechanically gathered a handful of wood from the basket and tossed it on the fire.
